domain_decisions.resolution_strategy: Resolve source gameId through the verified game crosswalk; generate team candidates from normalized labels and accept only corroborated source/team mappings.
Resolve source gameId first, then treat drive id as source-scoped within the verified game; never join a source id directly to a canonical id.
Flatten the nested teams payload to game/team/category/player/stat grain; resolve root game id, then verified team and athlete crosswalks before registry use.
Resolve gameId and driveId through verified parent mappings, then retain play id as source-scoped event identity with chronological event ordering.
Resolve game/team source ids through verified crosswalks, use names only for candidate generation, and quarantine field/season drift without discarding usable play partitions.
Flatten polls and ranked-team entries to poll/week/team grain, then resolve team labels or ids through verified team mappings; season/week alone cannot identify ranked teams.
Resolve team and athlete source ids in season scope; use first/last/team labels only as candidate evidence and preserve roster membership effective dates.
Resolve game, home team, away team, and venue source ids through verified crosswalks; use season and schedule context as corroborating natural-key evidence.
Resolve game/home/away source ids through verified crosswalks and corroborate with team labels, season, date, and official outcome context.
Flatten the nested teams payload to game/team/category/stat grain; resolve root game id and verified team mappings before registry use.
Create source-scoped team mappings from source id; use school and conference labels only for candidate generation and effective-dated corroboration.
Create source-scoped venue mappings from source id and corroborate with normalized name and location attributes before canonical acceptance.
